description: Hooks of this agent: aos functions run when an event happens (before_queue, after_queue, before_tool, after_tool, brain_failed, tool_added, after_start, after_stop, on_clock); the stack copy of this file overrides it by name, null turns one off. The timer hook is a place to hang something every 5 minutes (on_clock, every_ms 300000, AOS_CLOCK); its handler does nothing. The mail_notify hook looks at your mailbox every minute (on_clock, every_ms 60000) and, only when new letters came, puts one message "[aos] new_mail: N new letters from A, B. ..." in your queue (letters already waiting when you start or wake up are not announced, only ones that arrive later); turn it off or change the interval in your stack copy (self_hook rm / add with replace).
